literal: Water-even of the shade sweet-indeed; sulking-also lovers with-indeed sweet.
translation: Even water is pleasant only when it is in the shade. Sulking is pleasant only with those who love.
modern: நீரும் நிழலில் இருக்கும்போதே இனிமையாக இருக்கும். அதுபோல, ஊடலும் அன்புடையவர்களிடம் கொள்ளும்போதே இனிமையாக இருக்கும்.
explanation: Water gives true refreshment only when it is kept cool in the shade. In the same way, feigned anger or sulking is enjoyable only when it happens between true lovers. If there is no underlying love, sulking will only cause bitterness rather than sweet reconciliation. The couplet uses the natural image of shaded water to show how the context of deep affection makes temporary disagreements pleasant.
